properties.displayName: Bastion: block deletion of diagnostic settings
properties.description: Copy of the Azure Landing Zones policy DenyAction-DiagnosticLogs with an effect parameter added (the original has a fixed denyAction effect). Stops anyone, including an attacker with Contributor, from deleting diagnostic settings to blind Huginn. DenyAction supports only the delete action.
